testimonials.title: Hear It Straight
testimonials.description: No sugar-coating. Here's what happens when businesses stop wasting money on pretty pictures that don't work.

items.quote: We burned through three agencies who promised 'brand elevation.' DesignWorks just asked what needed to work better. Six months later, our conversion rate doubled. Turns out clarity beats clever every time.
items.author: Lacey Hoggan

items.quote: The subscription model saved us. No more $15k invoices for 'discovery phases.' Just honest design that works, delivered every month. Our CFO actually smiled when I renewed.
items.author: Olivia Murrish

items.quote: They told us our rebrand would take trade-offs. They were right. We cut the fluff, focused on what matters, and our customers finally get what we do. Best honest conversation we've had with an agency.
items.author: Rebecca Li

items.quote: DesignWorks doesn't do decoration. They solve real problems with design that works. Our bounce rate dropped 60% after they simplified our site. Sometimes boring is exactly what you need.
items.author: Rebecca Li

items.quote: First agency that didn't try to sell us a 'journey.' They just delivered clear, effective design that our team could actually use. No drama, no jargon, no wasted time. Exactly what we needed.
items.author: Ray Livingston
